description: Which x402 sellers earn the most: payTo addresses on Base ranked by USDC received over x402 in the last 30 days, with paying wallets, the biggest buyer's share and a read of whether the revenue is broad, one big customer, mostly catalogue crawlers or self-funded. Without a pass: the top 10, revenue rounded. With a pass: up to 200 with exact revenue, payment counts, active days, crawler and self-funded shares, and filters. Use when: you want to know who is really selling over x402, or to size a market. Do not use for: one seller in detail (settled_seller_reputation), or whether an endpoint delivers (settled_check). Base and x402 only; rebuilt nightly; buyer wallets are never named.

claimed.description: With a pass: only sellers who claimed their address on Settled
